name: Wealthfolio OG social card by Wealthfolio
description: A 1200×630 social card split roughly 55/45 between a text column and a product-mockup cluster on a warm cream gradient. The left column stacks the wordmark, a two-line serif headline that flips to italic on the second line for cadence, a gray sans subhead where two key words sit inside yellow marker-style highlights, and a dot-separated trust line. The right half shows a simplified desktop dashboard (big net-worth figure, olive-green area chart, green/red account rows) overlapped by an iPhone frame running the same UI, cropped by the canvas edge. The palette stays disciplined — cream, charcoal-olive ink, one yellow accent — so the single highlight gesture and the chart green do all the accent work.
